name: io.github.shahroz/ghl-mcp
title: GoHighLevel
description: Typed access to the whole GoHighLevel (HighLevel) CRM API from AI agents: contacts, opportunities, conversations, calendars, plus meta-tools reaching all 1,203 operations across 45 modules. Single static binary, agency-wide multi-location support, writes gated off by default.

environmentVariables.name: GHL_PIT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: GoHighLevel Private Integration Token, created in a sub-account under Settings -> Private Integrations. Either this or GHL_ACCESS_TOKEN is required.

environmentVariables.name: GHL_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: OAuth 2.0 access token, as an alternative to a Private Integration Token.

environmentVariables.name: GHL_LOCATION_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default sub-account (location) id used when a tool call omits location_id.

environmentVariables.name: GHL_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to permit writes, deletions, outbound messages and bookings. Off by default, so read-only tools work without risk.

environmentVariables.name: GHL_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL (proxies, testing).

environmentVariables.name: GHL_HTTP_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token callers must present on the HTTP endpoint. Strongly recommended whenever the port is reachable by anything but localhost.
